sections.heading: For Loop
sections.body: When you know exactly how many times you want to loop through a block of code, use the for loop instead of a while loop:

sections.heading: Syntax
sections.body: Expression 1 is executed (one time) before the execution of the code block. Expression 2 defines the condition for executing the code block. Expression 3 is executed (every time) after the code block has been executed.

sections.heading: Example
sections.body: Example explained Statement 1 sets a variable before the loop starts: int i = 0; Statement 2 defines the condition for the loop to run: i < 5. If the condition is true, the loop will start over again, if it is false, the loop will end.; Statement 3 increases a value each time the code block in the loop has been executed: i++
